# HC Figure Exemplars

Use this as a placement guide, not as a substitute for evidence.

| Paper need | Minimum artifact | Evidence source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Baseline comparison | grouped bar chart and source table | `figures/all_results.json` |
| Optimization convergence | trend chart | iteration trace written by code |
| Sensitivity | one-factor curve or tornado plot | controlled parameter sweep |
| Spatial allocation | polygon map with province-level data | authoritative or explicitly schematic geometry |
| Diagnostic | residual plot or calibration plot | model predictions and held-out observations |

Every visual must be cited in the surrounding paragraph and have a matching
entry in `figures/latex_includes.tex`.
